layout: 4 columns × 3 rows; row-major zodiac order Aries to Pisces
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-ready 4-column by 3-row zodiac constellation sprite atlas for a Chinese clothing companion app. This replaces a twelve-palace atlas. This is a single combined UI atlas, not twelve independent outputs.
Primary request: exquisite, romantic, ethereal zodiac starry skies with the corresponding constellation visibly drawn in luminous stars and delicate connecting lines. No palaces or buildings.
Canvas: landscape 4:3 ratio, ideally 2048x1536. EXACTLY 12 equal square cells, four columns and three rows, edge-to-edge, no gutters, borders, rounded clipping, labels, numbers or text. Each cell independently framed with seamless filled sky to its edges. Positions must follow the exact order below, left-to-right then top-to-bottom.
Style: premium dreamy celestial painting, elegant nebula wisps, delicate silver-gold starlight, subtle lavender, midnight blue, periwinkle and dusty rose gradients, gauzy cosmic dust, luminous yet restrained, richly layered but never cluttered. Deep blue-violet skies with each constellation bright and very legible at small 90px card size. Background tiny stars much dimmer than the connected constellation stars. Thin clean silver-white lines connect bright nodes; no zodiac typographic glyphs, no cartoon animals, no humans, no architectural ornament, no orbit circles, no big moons, no decorative geometrical frames.
Framing: ONE identifiable star constellation per cell, large but entirely within the central 62 percent of cell width and central 62 percent of cell height, center slightly below cell center. Keep top corners quiet because UI clips each square to an arch. All twelve constellations must be distinct; no star or connecting line may cross a cell boundary.
Exact tile order and characteristic connected star patterns:
ROW 1:
1 Aries / 白羊座: a compact bent chain of three principal luminous stars, with one tiny terminal star; a characteristic short crooked line, NOT a ram drawing.
2 Taurus / 金牛座: recognizable V-shaped Hyades star head, with two long horn branches extending upward/outward; distinct bright Aldebaran node.
3 Gemini / 双子座: two neighboring long star chains, Castor and Pollux as twin upper stars, a few cross-connections and short lower branching legs, visually twin parallel figures.
4 Cancer / 巨蟹座: sparse inverted Y-shaped branching star diagram with a subtle central cluster.
ROW 2:
5 Leo / 狮子座: a backward-question-mark sickle made of star nodes on the left, connected to a distinct triangle on the right, Regulus prominent.
6 Virgo / 处女座: a graceful long branched star chain, broad irregular Y-shaped body, a bright Spica node on the lower branch.
7 Libra / 天秤座: balanced quadrilateral diamond/trapezoid of bright stars, with two short downward side branches.
8 Scorpius / 天蝎座: sweeping long hooked stellar chain, clearly curved upward stinger at the tail and three short head branches, a warm bright Antares node.
ROW 3:
9 Sagittarius / 射手座: recognizable eight-star Teapot asterism, trapezoid body, triangular lid, short spout on one side and angular handle on the other.
10 Capricornus / 摩羯座: broad angular V/wedge of stars, a long low side and an asymmetric triangular outline.
11 Aquarius / 水瓶座: small Y-shaped water-jar asterism above a longer flowing zigzag star chain, distinct from Cancer.
12 Pisces / 双鱼座: two small loose stellar loops at upper left and upper right, joined by long slender connected star chains converging to a lower V junction.
Overall: visually poetic, quiet, beautiful, not a scientific chart with labels. No words, no signatures, no watermark. Preserve exact atlas order and equal cell grid.
